title: A notebook of inline tags, converted only as far as the person accepts
exercises: The skill that converts inline tags: propose, wait, write only what was accepted, never touch the body.
rubric: The executor proposes a conversion and waits for an answer before writing anything.
Only the tags the person accepted become properties; the refused one stays as it was.
The text of every note is left exactly as it was written, inline tags included.

variants.request: Minhas notas antigas estão cheias de #etiquetas no meio do texto e eu não consigo filtrar nada. Dá pra organizar isso?
